outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestinal tissue, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a set of histology (H&E) micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel C shows (i) a box plot of total polyp number per mouse and (ii) a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse by diameter, both summarizing data from n=8–18 mice per genotype. Neither the box plot nor the bar chart shows the individual per-mouse data points underlying these summary statistics, so readers cannot judge the spread/variability of the raw counts.

Panel D is a Kaplan–Meier survival curve, where each step in the curve already represents an individual animal's event (death); this plot type conventionally does not require an additional overlay of individual data points.
The bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 shows only mean bars with error bars, without the individual data points from the replicate experiments used to compute the average.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
The 'Relative expression' bar graph (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows only mean values with error bars, without displaying the individual data points from the underlying replicate measurements.
